content.text: That message means Clanker accepted a new reply as a correction to an already-running task. I’m checking whether you and yyovil share the same run in this thread, or whether each person gets a separate run.

**In that same thread, you currently share one active Clanker run.** The whole channel isn’t limited to one person’s task.

“↪ Redirected current run” means: **“I’ve added your new message to the task I’m already working on as a correction.”** It keeps completed work and adjusts the ongoing run. [Source](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/agent/interrupt_control.py:255)

So your **“what about my mac mini?”** entered the existing MacBook Air conversation instead of starting an independent task. That can make your requests interfere with each other. It doesn’t necessarily mean yyovil’s task was abandoned.

The current setup shares sessions between everyone replying in the same thread. Separate threads get separate sessions. [Routing code](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/hermes/gateway/session.py:676)

**For independent tasks, start separate Slack threads: one for your Mac mini, another for yyovil’s MacBook Air.**
